concerns.text: Task T000 (Execute Baseline) is placed in Phase 2 (Foundational) but depends on T003 (Data Loader) and T005 (Schema). However, T000 is listed BEFORE T003 and T005 in the task list. T000 cannot execute without the data loader (T003) to fetch the weights and the schema (T005) to record outcomes. Reorder T000 to appear after T003 and T005.

Task T014 (Implement state_mapper) explicitly states 'Depends on T046'. However, T046 (Define replan_support flag in SymbolicState schema) is listed in Phase 2 (Foundational) *after* T006, while T014 is in Phase 3 (US1). The dependency is correctly noted, but T046 is buried in Phase 2. Ensure T046 is executed before T014. The current ordering in the list (T046 before T014) is technically correct, but T046 is visually separated from the main schema definition task T005. Consider grouping T046 with T005 or ensuring T005 is clearly the producer of the schema T046 modifies.

Task T032 (Implement stats_analysis) depends on T000 (Baseline Results) and T026 (Execution Logs). T000 is in Phase 2, T026 is in Phase 4 (US2). T032 is in Phase 5 (US3). The ordering is correct (T000 -> T026 -> T032). However, T032 is listed as [P] (Parallel). It cannot be parallel with T026 or T000. The [P] tag on T032 is incorrect as it is a consumer of artifacts from previous phases. Remove [P] from T032.

Task T041 (Calculate Physics Fidelity Gap) depends on T038 (Oracle Results) and T026 (Execution Logs). T038 is in Phase 6 (US4), T026 is in Phase 4 (US2). T041 is in Phase 6. The ordering is correct. However, T041 is marked [P]. It cannot run in parallel with T038 or T026. Remove [P] from T041.

Task T044a (Orchestrate comparative execution) depends on T042, T043, and US1/US2 completion. T042 and T043 are in Phase 7. T044a is in Phase 7. The ordering is correct. However, T044a is marked [P]. It cannot run in parallel with T042/T043 (producers) or US1/US2 (producers). Remove [P] from T044a.
Task T044b (Statistical comparison) depends on T044a. T044b is marked [P]. It cannot run in parallel with T044a. Remove [P] from T044b.

Task T010 (Implement controller_adapter) is marked [P] in the header but the description says 'This task is atomic and sequential; [P] tag removed'. The task list still shows `[P]` next to T010. Remove the `[P]` tag from T010 to reflect the sequential nature described in the implementation notes.

Task T005 (Create base entity schemas) is in Phase 2. Task T046 (Define replan_support flag) is also in Phase 2 but listed after T006. T046 modifies the schema created in T005. Ensure T005 is completed before T046. The current list order (T005, T046, T006) is correct, but T006 (Contract tests) depends on T005. T006 is listed after T046. This is acceptable as T006 depends on T005, not T046. However, T006 should ideally be grouped with T005/T046 as they are all foundational schema tasks.
